conclusion: Hitting a 20-40% favorable move happens often (69-86%) and fast (2-6 min median) using real historical Kalshi contract prices. But holding to settlement outperformed every early-exit threshold tested in aggregate ROI (12.4% vs 8.8-10.9%), consistently across all thresholds and both a partial and full sample, though not at full statistical significance (p=0.127 for the best variant). Of trades that hit a target early, 77-85% would have settled in the buyer's favor anyway (upside foregone); only 15-23% would have reversed to a loss (genuinely saved by exiting early). Deployed at 35% in paper_trader.py anyway since paper trading is meant to test the intended strategy, not the backtest optimum.
